facts.text: Received 1,000 comments. Removed nothing. Analysed 1,000 comments, of which 972 are distinct texts. The LLM labelled 100% of the analysed comments.
Sentiment across 1,000 comments: 6.0% negative (60), 23.5% positive (235), 70.5% neutral (705).
What people are doing in their comments: other 60.8%, praise 21.3%, question 7.4%, complaint 5.8%, suggestion 2.7%, purchase intent 2.0%.
iPhone usage: 136 comments (13.6% of all), 16.2% negative, 26.5% positive, impact score 22.0.
iPad products: 202 comments (20.2% of all), 5.4% negative, 28.2% positive, impact score 11.0.
Apple store: 195 comments (19.5% of all), 5.6% negative, 30.8% positive, impact score 11.0.
Google parties: 200 comments (20.0% of all), 2.5% negative, 18.5% positive, impact score 5.0.
Android apps: 76 comments (7.6% of all), 6.6% negative, 23.7% positive, impact score 5.0.
General opinion: 103 comments (10.3% of all), 3.9% negative, 14.6% positive, impact score 4.0.
